name: MetalBlurHash
baseline: Wolt's reference BlurHash Swift encoder and decoder (CPU)
verdict_reason: The 250x decode figure (3.267 s to 0.013 s) holds for a 3840 x 2560 output on an M1 Max in a Release build, but the README calls its numbers illustrative, and placeholders are normally decoded at a few dozen pixels and scaled up, where GPU dispatch overhead would eat much of the gap. No small-size or iPhone numbers are published.
tier_reason: Public XCTest performance tests and test plan in the repository, Release test configuration in the shared scheme, and M1 Max hardware stated.
workload: Decode a 9 x 9-component BlurHash into a 3840 x 2560 image; encode a 3648 x 5472 image with 9 x 9 components.
toolchain: Release test configuration in the shared Xcode scheme; Xcode version not stated
one_liner: Metal port of BlurHash; decodes a 3840 x 2560 placeholder 250x faster than Wolt's CPU code on an M1 Max.
how_it_is_fast: Decoding BlurHash means summing up to 81 cosine basis functions at every output pixel. MetalBlurHash runs that per-pixel sum as a Metal compute kernel, so pixels are evaluated in parallel on the GPU instead of in nested Swift loops on one CPU core. Encoding moves the per-component sums over the source image to the GPU the same way.
use_it_when: Generating BlurHash strings from full-resolution photos on device, where encoding took 32 s on the CPU
Decoding placeholders at or near screen resolution
skip_it_when: Decoding small placeholders (for example 32 x 32) and scaling them up, as the BlurHash authors recommend: no numbers show a GPU win there
Widgets and other background contexts, where GPU command buffers are refused
Code that cannot handle a nil image when Metal initialization fails
caveats: Measured on a Mac (M1 Max), not an iPhone
The README calls the times and multipliers 'illustrative'
Craft's blog post on the same benchmark prints the decode speedup as 25x, a typo for 250x (3.267 / 0.013)
One output size per task; no curve across sizes
tradeoffs: Requires Metal; returns nil if Metal setup fails
No GPU work from widgets or the background
